recipe.name: probe-experts-forward-primal-vjp
recipe.hypothesis: Cycle7local3: inspect a specific KS3 gradient mismatch after scalar grids and forward-precision variants failed. Original forward uses joint-GS32 coefficients and FP16-stage Horner, then FP16 pre-square ReLU; original VJP multiplies the smooth FP32 Jacobian by twice a separately recomputed smooth preactivation. Change only that squared-ReLU multiplier to twice the original forward-rounded ReLU, retaining the original smooth polynomial/tanh Jacobian and coefficient identity STE. Every forward, evaluation, projection product, parameter, initialization and optimizer rate remains original. This explicitly changes initial gradients through FP16 rounding and is a hybrid surrogate, not an exact derivative of the discrete map. Validate against independent Torch autograd of the defined detached-correction surrogate, measure effect sizes, run bounded actual-model state/cost gate (maximum3percent slowdown), then fixedV2 elapsed-time screening. No gain assumed and no unchanged rejected recipe repeated.
recipe.cap_rule: Stop before starting an update if current elapsed plus 1.05 times the maximum of the last four observed stage update durations plus setup reserve reaches the exact budget. Setup remains on the original timer. Report any actual overrun; strict qualification has no tolerance.
recipe.preserved: Original full PR393 MoE8 top1 router, non-KS3 blocks, CPLM, global update sizes over eight logical ranks, objective schedule, optimizer settings and FP8 formats. Full 24-update warmup restored before continuous training. Raw full validation, no canonical mask, no final window extension, no tail shipping.
recipe.hardware_change_scope: Opt-in shared nongrouped FP8 GEMM tiles across attention, dense MLP and output head; default MLP dispatch remains legacy.
recipe.evaluation_protocol: Capture live stage-two YaRN frequencies/attention scales on first reach of640/1408 windows. For terminal stage four or full-schedule completion only, restore those nonlearned buffers and use640/1408 evaluation arguments. Preserve raw learned weights, training schedule and all updates; no canonical mask, tail shipping or final window extension. Early-stage evaluation remains incompatible. All restoration/rebuild/readback/setup is inside original training timer; no strict qualification if actual elapsed exceeds902.3592145430011.

forward_primal_vjp_evidence.scope: KS3 expert backward squared-ReLU multiplier only; original smooth Jacobian and every forward/evaluation retained.
forward_primal_vjp_evidence.motivation: Original ks3_moe._vjp uses FP32 x+spine+warped while pinned _spine_features NL1 rounds the primal through FP16. The directed FP32-Horner experiment changed forward and was rejected; this instead changes backward at identical forward values.
